//: Launch contracts tools/check-launch-contracts.cjs checks the system's app-to-app launches against (docs/LAUNCH-CONTRACTS.md). Phoenix's own apps list the launch params they read in their appinfo.json ("phoenix": {"launchParams"}); the original apps they cannot list them in, so they are here, each with the file that reads them.

universal.//: Keys the system adds or consumes, not the app: the runtime's returnToCaller ($caller), a scheduled activity's launch ($activity), luna-sysmgr's own flag for a launch without a card preview ($disableCardPreLaunch, WebAppMgr's).

runtime.//: Keys the runtime takes for an app before it opens: {id: com.palm.app.printmanager, params: {runHeadless}} starts no card (runtime/phoenix-runtime.js, the Print Manager); com.palm.app.help {target: "http://help.palm.com/<area>/..."} becomes Help's {topic} (aliasParams, HELP_TOPICS).

com.palm.app.contacts.source: third_party/core-apps/com.palm.app.contacts/app/ContactsApp.js:93-125 (handleLaunchParams: launchType editContact | newContact | pseudo-card | addToExisting | showPerson with id, contact or person; target: a vCard file) and compat/rootfs/usr/palm/applications/com.palm.app.contacts/app/phoenix-launch.js (launchType reminder with personId and focusField, personId alone, target opencontact://)

com.palm.app.email.source: third_party/core-apps/com.palm.app.email/nowindow/source/Launch.js:201-252 (relaunch: target or uri mailto: or file:, newEmail {...}, the legacy account / attachments / recipients / summary / text) and compose/source/Composition.js:373-498; emailId: compat/rootfs/usr/palm/applications/com.palm.app.email/mail/source/phoenix-compat.js

com.palm.app.notes.source: compat/rootfs/usr/palm/applications/com.palm.app.notes/app/views/GridView.js:131-140 (the original's goToGrid with the launch params, app/views/AppView.js:66-68)

com.palm.app.browser.source: third_party/isis/isis-browser/source/BrowserApp.js:152-153 (p.target || p.url); scene is the Mojo browser's scene name (luna-applauncher sends scene: "page"), which the isis browser never needed

exceptions.why: the original Calendar never read it either: its missed reminders view was a TODO (LunaAppManager.js:270-276, App.js:378)
Settings' Date & Time page opens; it has no separate "set the time temporarily" mode to start
Settings' Just Type page opens, its search providers ("Add More") are on it
{preferences: true} opens Settings' Phone page (APP_ROUTES); a network search is not something the simulated modem has
the App Catalog page of HP's Facebook app, which Phoenix does not have ("absent"); the Marketplace opens

absent.//: Ids the original apps launch that Phoenix has no app for, and why. The checker lists them as ❌ but does not fail on them.
absent.com.palm.app.swmanager: The Software Manager (luna-systemui AppManagerAlerts.js opens it from its app install alerts): not in the open-source release, and Phoenix has none; the Marketplace lists the installed apps.
absent.com.palm.app.dataimport: The data import app (luna-systemui SystemManagerAlerts.js opens it after a data transfer): not in the open-source release, and Phoenix has none.
absent.com.palm.app.enyo-facebook: HP's Facebook app (the browser's Share Link > Facebook): not in the open-source release; Phoenix shares through the share sheet.
